content: Yesus upun a'an kanakarne
Yesus Kristus upun a'an: Yesus eni rai Daud upun anan; Daud eni Abraham upun anan.
Yesus upun a'anhe nano Abraham rakan Daud kanakarne
Abraham na'ori Isak, Isak na'ori Yakup, Yakup na'ori Yehuda noro mo'oniwalinhe idaweli ida.
Yehuda na'ori Peres noro Zerah (woro'o eniyenihe inna naran Tamar) Peres na'ori Hezron, Hezron na'ori Ram,
Ram na'ori Aminadab, Aminadab na'ori Nahason, Nahason na'ori Salmon,
Salmon na'ori Boas (Boas eniyeni inna naran Rahab),
Boas na'ori Obed (Obed eniyeni inna naran Rut), Obed na'ori Isai,

la Isai na'ori Daud ma namwali rai Israel. Yesus upun a'anhe nano Daud rakan lere Babel enihe kele Israel rodi laa rir nohe Daud na'ori Salomo (Salomo eniyeni inna naran Batseba, la nonolu Uria hono ma namwalumedi).
Salomo na'ori Rehabeam, Rehabeam na'ori Abia, Abia na'ori Asa,
Asa na'ori Yosafat, Yosafat na'ori Yoram, Yoram na'ori Uzia,
Uzia na'ori Yotam, Yotam na'ori Ahas, Ahas na'ori Hizkia,
Hizkia na'ori Manasye, Manasye na'ori Amon, Amon na'ori Yosia,
la Yosia na'ori Yekonya noro mo'oniwalinhe lere Babel enihe keledi Israel, rodi laa rir nohe.
Yesus upun a'anhe nano lere manin Babel kele Israel rodi laa rir nohe rakan lere momori Yesus
Nano lere Babel enihe keledi Israel, Yekonya na'ori Sealtiel, Sealtiel na'ori Zerubabel,
Zerubabel na'ori Abihud, Abihud na'ori Elyakim, Elyakim na'ori Azur,
Azur na'ori Zadok, Zadok na'ori Akim, Akim na'ori Eliud,
Eliud na'ori Eleazar, Eleazar na'ori Matan, Matan na'ori Yakup,
la Yakup na'ori Yusup man ho Maria. Maria eniyeni mori Yesus man rapolu Kristus.

Ende Yesus upun a'anhe nano Abraham rakan Daud, ku rewen idaweli wo'akka; nano Daud rakan lere manin Babel enihe keledi Israel rodi laa rir nohe, ku rewen idaweli wo'akka haenhi; nano lere Israel laa noho Babel rakan Yesus Kristus Nin lere, ku rewen idaweli wo'akka wali'ur.
Roh Kudus nodi molollo Maria ihin kemen penia mori Yesus

Lere momori Yesus onneni lirna la'an hi'i heheni: Yesus inna Maria noro aman Yusup, ida ma naledi honorok aki ida me'e, maa ka ramkuru wuku makun. Roh Kudus nodi molollo Maria ihin kemen, penia nornoro raramne me'e.

Maa, Yusup ka nauroin Roh Kudus nodi molollo Maria kemen makun, de an pene'ek Maria larlewenedi woro'ohe rira honorok aki ma namnehe na'alono me'e. Yusup eni ri man akin mou la namdudu, penia ai namhene wakunu nano'onyaka Maria lolo heri kalarna, de nanoin kalla namehin leke yon ho Maria me'e.

Alam ida nine, Yusup naho'ok nakail nina aki eniyeni mene namkuru la namarmi. Namlilinnohi Makromod Lalap Nin hophopon a'am raram mai nalhari kemen Yusup lolo nina namarmi na'aheni, “Yusup, Daud upun anan o, Tatana man minle Maria ihin kemen onne, Roh Kudus nina molollo, de yon mamka'uk more ho.
Rakan Maria nina lere alam nokor, an mori mo'oniyane. Lere onne waki naran Yesus, ono Ai penia man huri we'er Nin ri nano dohohale nin molollo.”
Onnenihe na'akeme namwali lekpananne na'akuku na'anokor inhawa Makromod Lalap na'aheniyedi lolo Nin nabi na'ahenia,

“Dernala! Maekrara ida ma kan ho makun nornoro raramne, de moriyana mo'oni ida. Tatan eniyeni rin waki naran Imanuel.” Nano wanakunu Ibrani, naran ‘Imanuel’ napa'ahne, ‘Makromod Lalap aiyedi ik leken kalarna me'e.’
Yusup namake ne, lernohi inhawa man Makromod Lalap Nina hophopon a'am raram hohopon onneni, de ai nala Maria namwali hono,
maa noro Maria ka ramkuru wuku hehen nanumene rakan Maria moriyedi mo'oniyana onneni. Enla Yusup waki naran Yesus.

footnotes.text: Rahab eniyeni man paku suwar noho Israel nin man koklolo na'inau woro'o lolo kota Yeriko.
